title: Headline snap
description: Three big words snap in from the right row by row with a capped overshoot and a speed smear, hold, then get pushed out while a second set of three snaps in behind a feathered seam. For a feature launch or a claim. 5 s, silent, 9:16.

slots.name: first
slots.note: Three words split by |, at most 9 characters each; the third takes the accent.

slots.name: second
slots.note: The three words that replace them, split by |, at most 9 characters each.

slots.name: label
slots.note: A short top label (brand or event), at most 20 characters.

slots.name: footer
slots.note: The bright start of the bottom line (a date, a URL).

slots.name: footerRest
slots.note: The muted rest of the bottom line, starting with a space.

slots.name: muted
slots.note: The muted part of the bottom line.

slots.name: accent
slots.note: The third word of each set and the dot.

beats.label: First set
beats.visual: Three big words snap in from the right, row by row, overshoot a little and settle crisp.

beats.label: Second set
beats.visual: The first set is pushed out left while the second set snaps in behind a feathered seam, row by row.
